candidates.formal_type:
∀ {k G : Type u} [inst : Field.{u} k] [inst_1 : IsAlgClosed.{u} k] [inst_2 : Group.{u} G] [inst_3 : Fintype.{u} G]
  [inst_4 : DecidableEq.{u + 1} G] [inst_5 : NeZero.{u} (Nat.cast.{u} (Nat.card.{u} G))] (D : IrrepDecomp.{u, u} k G),
  Eq.{u + 1} (Etingof.FrobeniusDeterminant.{u, u} k G)
    (HSMul.hSMul.{u, u, u}
      (Int.cast.{u} (Units.val.{0} (DFunLike.coe.{u + 1, u + 1, 1} Equiv.Perm.sign.{u} (Equiv.inv.{u} G))))
      (Finset.prod.{0, u} Finset.univ.{0} fun i =>
        HPow.hPow.{u, 0, u} (IrrepDecomp.blockPoly.{u} D i) (IrrepDecomp.d.{u, u} D i)))
